spans.s:
Chardis occurs often in the Rigveda, and occasionally later, denoting a secure dwelling-place. The word appears to be incorrectly written, because the metre shows that the first syllable is always short. Roth accordingly suggested that chadis should be read instead. But chadis means ‘roof,’ while chardis never has that sense. Bartholomae is therefore probably right in suggesting some other form, such as Chaḍis.
